        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = scanner.nextLong();
        long y = scanner.nextLong();
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        long bestx = 0, besty = 1;
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            long temp = (x * i) / y;
            long rem = x * i - temp * y;
            if (rem > (temp + 1) * y - x * i) temp = temp + 1;
            long a = besty * (x * i - temp * y);
            long b = i * (x * besty - y * bestx);
            if (a < 0) a = -a;
            if (b < 0) b = -b;
            if (a < b) {
                bestx = temp;
                besty = i;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(bestx + "/" + besty);
    }
}
